title: Time-course transcriptomic analysis of Petunia xhybrida leaves under water deficit stress using RNA sequencing.
authors: Park, Suejin; Wijeratne, Asela J; Moon, Youyoun; Waterland, Nicole L
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA测序分析矮牵牛叶片缺水胁迫下的时间序列转录组，虽鉴定到转录因子家族表达变化，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属纯转录组表达分析，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Water deficit limits plant growth and development, resulting in quality loss of horticultural crops. However, there is limited information on gene regulation and signaling pathways related to water deficit stress response at multiple time points. The objective of this research was to investigate global gene expression patterns under water deficit stress to provide an insight into how petunia (Petunia xhybrida 'Mitchell Diploid') responded in the process of stress. Nine-week-old petunias were irrigated daily or placed under water stress by withholding water. Stressed plants reduced stomatal conductance after five days of water deficit, indicating they perceived stress and initiated stress response mechanisms. To analyze transcriptomic changes at the early stage of water deficit, leaf tissue samples were collected 1, 3, and 5 days after water was withheld for RNA sequencing. Under water deficit stress, 154, 3611, and 980 genes were upregulated and 41, 2806, and 253 genes were downregulated on day 1, 3, and 5, respectively. Gene Ontology analysis revealed that redox homeostasis processes through sulfur and glutathione metabolism pathways, and hormone signal transduction, especially abscisic acid and ethylene, were enriched under water deficit stress. Thirty-four transcription factor families were identified, including members of AP2/ERF, NAC, MYB-related, C2H2, and bZIP families, and TFs in AP2/ERF family was the most abundant in petunia. Interestingly, only one member of GRFs was upregulated on day 1, while most of TFs were differentially expressed on day 3 and/or 5. The transcriptome data from this research will provide valuable molecular resources for understanding the early stages of water stress-responsive networks as well as engineering petunia with enhanced water stress tolerance.
abstract_zh: 水分亏缺限制了植物的生长发育，导致园艺作物品质下降。然而，关于多个时间点下水分亏缺胁迫响应的基因调控和信号通路信息有限。本研究旨在探究水分亏缺胁迫下的全局基因表达模式，以深入了解矮牵牛（Petunia xhybrida 'Mitchell Diploid'）在胁迫过程中的响应机制。九周龄的矮牵牛每日灌溉或通过停止浇水置于水分胁迫下。受胁迫植株在水分亏缺五天后气孔导度降低，表明它们感知到胁迫并启动了胁迫响应机制。为分析水分亏缺早期阶段的转录组变化，在停止浇水后第1、3和5天采集叶片组织样本进行RNA测序。在水分亏缺胁迫下，第1、3和5天分别有154、3611和980个基因上调，以及41、2806和253个基因下调。基因本体论分析显示，通过硫和谷胱甘肽代谢途径的氧化还原稳态过程以及激素信号转导，特别是脱落酸和乙烯，在水分亏缺胁迫下显著富集。鉴定出34个转录因子家族，包括AP2/ERF、NAC、MYB相关、C2H2和bZIP家族的成员，其中AP2/ERF家族的转录因子在矮牵牛中最为丰富。有趣的是，第1天仅有一个GRFs成员上调，而大多数转录因子在第3天和/或第5天差异表达。本研究的转录组数据将为理解水分胁迫响应网络的早期阶段以及改良矮牵牛增强水分胁迫耐受性提供宝贵的分子资源。
